preconditions.description: The length of the array n is between 3 and 5000.

postconditions.description: The guessed array a has the same length as the input n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 100000 for ai in a)
postconditions.description: All elements in the guessed array a are positive integers not exceeding 100000.

postconditions.expression: sums == [ai + aj for i, j in zip(indices1, indices2)]
postconditions.description: The sums of the guessed array elements correspond to the requested sums.
